text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Basque parliament to present its prisoners' plan to interior ministry and ETA
- Chairman Jiang Zemin new "strong man" of China
- Government to approve today a new list of measures to spur the economy
EL MUNDO
- Basque parliament agrees to explain to Mayor and Txikierdi its plan for prisoners
- 15 liberalisation measures that the cabinet of ministers will approve today
- (Ex-Civil Guard Chief Luis) Roldan asks to be put in liberty, kept in custody like Vera
DIARIO 16
- Roldan "I did not flee"
CINCO DIAS
- Telefonica negotiates the distribution of its assets with the state...after more than a half century of an amicable marriage
- CEOE (employers' association) says that the insertion proposed by CCOO (union) doesn't mean anything
- The captains Frudesa and Pescanova are twins; suit filed against Young & Rubicam for plagery
EXPANSION
- The government bets on the investment funds to animate the economy
- BBV will divide the nominal value of its shares to capture more shareholders
- (Endesa chairman) Martin Villa closes the Fuster stage in Endesa and reorganises the management team
- The government cuts 10 percent off international telephone rates
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Treasury director general Jaime Caruana: "Long term interest rates can fall at any time"
- Price of used housing stalls and new (housing) grows belows CPI
- The Metro of Madrid acquires trains for 16 billion
- Telefonica cuts calls to Europe by nine percent, to the U.S. by 15 percent
